item.title: Maryland needs this podcast. Now.
item.description: Three longtime colleagues and friends – Dori Henry, Josh Kurtz and David Nitkin – are joining forces to launch Maryland Now, a new podcast that will go beyond the headlines to explore the forces shaping Maryland’s politics, policy and public life.

item.title: Baltimore Weekend Events: Poké-Rave, The Great Gatsby, Echoes of Motown, and more.
item.description: From a Pokémon-themed rave to the touring production of "The Great Gatsby" musical, this weekend has plenty in store for Baltimore.

item.title: Protest on Friday will call for shutting down Baltimore ICE operations
item.description: Justice organizations will demonstrate in solidarity with Minneapolis and to call for shutting down ICE operations at 31 Hopkins Plaza.

item.title: Baltimore native comedian Stavros Halkias to perform at the Lyric in April
item.description: Baltimore native and comedian Stavros Halkias will perform stand-up at Lyric Baltimore – and a third show has just been added due to popular demand.

item.title: Suspect in 3-Year-Old Murder Case Pleads Not Criminally Responsible
item.description: After two postponements, defendant Jayquan Bridgeman, 26, pleaded not criminally responsible (NCR) to the first-degree of Michael Washington, 43 in a hearing on Jan. 28.

item.title: House of Ruth Maryland names Katie Allston as new executive director
item.description: House of Ruth Maryland has selected a new executive director as it nears its 50th year helping those suffering intimate partner violence.

item.title: Maryland Senate gives initial approval to two ICE restriction bills
item.description: Legislation to ban formal agreements between local law enforcement and U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) cleared its first vote in the Maryland Senate on Thursday.

item.title: Everyman Theatre names Brandon Weinbrenner as new artistic director
item.description: Brandon Weinbrenner, currently the artistic director at the Alley Theatre, will serve as Everyman Theatre's next artistic director.
